title: Trove task event
description: One line of tasks/<source>/events/YYYY-MM.jsonl: the task shape (flattened) plus time + kind. Additive evolution: readers tolerate unknown fields.

time.description: RFC3339 local time of the lifecycle event

source.description: collector id; identical to the source folder name (lowercase/digits/dash)

id.description: source-native task id, the dedupe key

status.description: task state at the event (flattened from the task shape)

completed.description: RFC3339 local completion time; for a recurring task, the last instance completion
